Name: rich
Basic relationship: rich
\S{k=0, \inf, a^k}, \int{0, \inf, a^x*dx} -> (|a|<1 -> convergence, |a|>=1 -> divergence)
\S{k=1, \inf, k^n}, \int{1, \inf, x^n*dx} -> (n<-1 -> convergence, n>=-1 -> divergence)
\int{0, 1, x^n*dx} -> (n>-1 -> convergence, n<=-1 -> divergence)
\int{1, \inf, 1/(x*ln(x))} -> divergent, \int{1, \inf, 1/(x*ln(ln(x)))*dx} -> divergent

Name: Comparable (check convergence)/Jämförelsesats (Jämförelsetest)
Basic relationship:
f and g continous [a, b), 0 <= f(x) <= g(x) for [a, b)
1. \int{a, b, g(x)dx} convergent -> \int{a, b, f(x)dx} convergent
2. \int{a, b, f(x)dx} divergent -> \int{a, b, g(x)dx} divergent

Geometric:
I_f: \int{a, b, f(x)dx}, I_g: \int{a, b, g(x)dx}
M_f = {(a, y): x in (a, b), y in [0, f(x)}, M_y = {(x, y): x in (a, b), y in [0, g(x)]}
f(x)<=g(x) -> M_f \subset M_g, I_g convergent -> M_g finite -> M_f finite -> I_f convergent
I_f divergent -> M_f infinite -> M_g infinite -> I_g divergent

Name: Rational/Radical expression
Basic relationship: Compare with managable power forms
Presetted values:
\int{1, \inf, x^98/(x^100+x^10)dx} <= \int{1, \inf, x^98/x^100dx} -> convergent
\int{1, \inf, 1/(x^10+[x^7+x^3+1])} < \int{1, inf, 1/x^10} -> convergent
\int{0, 1, 1/(x+sqrt(x))dx} < \int{0, 1, 1/sqrt(x)dx} -> convergent
\int{0, \inf, 1/sqrt(x^4+2)dx} < \int{0, \inf, 1/sqrt(x^4)dx} -> convergent
\int{1, \inf, 1/(x+sqrt(x)dx} > \int{1, \inf, 1/(x+x)dx} -> divergent

Name: Exponential expression
Basic relationship:
1. Compare with managable exponential expressions (geometrical sums)
2. Compare and reduce to managable power forms

Name: Logarithmic expression
Basic relationship: Remove ln
ln(x)<=x

Name: Trigonometric expression
Basic relationship:
sin x <= x
cos x <= 1
arctan x <= \pi/2

Name: Limit Comparison Criterion/Limit Comparison Test/jämförelsekriteriet på gränsvärdesform
Basic relationship:
f(x) >= 0, g(x) >= 0
f, g, continous [a, b), lim{x->b-, f(x)/g(x)}>0 or continous (a, b], lim{x->a+, f(x)/g(x)}>0
-> \int{a, b, f(x)dx} and \int{a, b, g(x)dx} are either convergent or divergent

Presetted values: \int{0, \pi, 1/(x+sin(x))}, f(x) = 1/(x+sin(x)), g(x) = 1/(x+x) -> divergent, lim{x->0+ f(x)/g(x)}=1>0, -> divergent

Name: Absolute Convergence Theorem, Absolut konvergens
Basic relationship: \int{a, b, |f(x)|dx} convergent -> \int{a, b, f(x)dx}

Presetted values:
\int{\pi, \inf, sin(x)/xdx} = {\pi, \inf, [-cos(x)/x]} - \int{\pi, \inf, cos(x)/x^2dx} -> convergent
\int{\pi, \inf, |cos(x)/x^2|dx} <= \int{\pi, \inf, 1/x^2dx} -> convergent -> \int{\pi, \inf, cos(x)/x^2dx} -> convergent

Name: Conditional convergence
Basic relationship: \int{a, b, |f(x)|dx} divergent -> \int{a, b, f(x)dx} conditionally convergent

Name: Integral and series
Basic relationship:
Positive increasing: \int{1, N, f(x)*dx} <= \S{k=1, N, f(k)} <= \int{1, N, f(x)*dx} + f(N)
Positive decreasing: \int{1, N+1, f(x)*dx} <= \S{k=1, N, f(k)} <= \int{1, N, f(x)*dx}

Name: Integral test/Cauchys jämförelsesats (Integralkriteriet)
Basic relationship:
f positive continous and decreasing x>=1
\S{k=1, \inf, f(k)} -> \int{1, \inf, f(x)dx}

\S{k=0, \inf, a_k} convergent -> lim{k->\inf, a_k} = 0
lim{k->\inf, a_k} != 0 -> \S{k=0, \inf, a_k} divergent
lim{k->\inf, a_k/b_k} = A != 0 -> \S{k=0, \inf, a_k} ~ \S{k=0, \inf, b_k} convergence/divergence

Name: Cauchys rotkriteritum
Basic relationship: \S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, lim{k->\inf, (a_k)^k} = A < 1 -> convergent, A>1 -> divergent

Name: d'Alemberts kvotkriteritum
Basic relationship: \S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, lim{k->\inf, |(a_(k+1))/(a_k)|} = A < 1 -> convergent, A>1 -> divergent

Name: Leibnitz' kriteritum
Basic relationship:
Alternating series/Alternerande serie
\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, |a_(k+1)|<=|a_k| -> lim{k->\inf, a_k} = 0 -> convergent

Name: Nolltest
Basic relationship: \S{k=0, \inf, arctan(x)}, lim{x->\inf, arctan(x)} != 0 -> divergent
